# Knowledge Commons

> An open-access, community-driven scholarly platform enabling researchers, academics, and professionals to collaborate, share work, and build sustainable open knowledge infrastructure.

Knowledge Commons (hcommons.org) serves as a federated network of discipline-specific and professional communities, including MLA Commons, ARLIS/NA Commons, and others. The platform prioritizes open access, open source principles, and community sustainability through membership programs and institutional partnerships.

## Getting Started

- [Knowledge Commons - Open access, open source, open to all](https://hcommons.org): Homepage for Knowledge Commons, open-access scholarly platform
- [Membership - Knowledge Commons](https://hcommons.org/membership): Membership registration and account creation for Knowledge Commons
- [About Knowledge Commons – Your Home for Digital Scholarly Work](https://sustaining.hcommons.org): About page describing Knowledge Commons mission and features

## Community & Engagement

- [News Feed - Knowledge Commons](https://hcommons.org/activity): Activity feed showing community updates and member engagement
- [KC Champions – About Knowledge Commons](https://about.hcommons.org/kc-champions): KC Champions membership program with supporter benefits and tiers
- [News – About Knowledge Commons](https://about.hcommons.org/news): News archive featuring community updates and announcements

## Discipline-Specific Communities

- [MLA Commons – An online community for MLA members](https://www.mla.hcommons.org): MLA Commons scholarly network for Modern Language Association
- [ARLIS/NA Commons – An online community for ARLIS/NA members](https://www.arlisna.hcommons.org): ARLIS/NA partner community for art information professionals
- [SAH Commons – An online community for SAH members](https://sah.hcommons.org): SAH Commons online community for Society of Architectural Historians
- [UP Commons – An online community for UP members](https://up.hcommons.org): UP Commons for Association of University Presses members
- [STEM Ed+ Commons](https://stemedplus.hcommons.org): STEM Ed+ Commons collaborative platform for science education

## Sustainability & Support

- [Become a KC Champion – About Knowledge Commons](https://about.hcommons.org/2026/01/26/become-a-kc-champion): Announcement introducing KC Champions membership program
- [Sustainability through Community – About Knowledge Commons](https://about.hcommons.org/2026/01/30/sustainability-through-community): Article on community-based sustainability for open scholarly infrastructure
- [Digital Scholar Donates $20,000 to Knowledge Commons (and Why that Gift Matters) – About Knowledge Commons](https://about.hcommons.org/2026/02/03/digital-scholar-donates-20000-to-knowledge-commons-and-why-that-gift-matters): Announcement of Digital Scholar donation supporting open infrastructure
